name: ddl-dml-select
description: CREATE TABLE persists through the schema registry, INSERT lands in .yykv and SELECT reads it back.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE harness_probe (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(64))
SELECT id, label FROM harness_probe WHERE id = 1
UPDATE harness_probe SET label = 'alpha-updated' WHERE id = 1
SELECT label FROM harness_probe WHERE id = 1
